caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design of an elaborate dress rendered predominantly in shades of light blue and white. The dress features a fitted, corset-like bodice with decorative buttons down the center front, extending into a full-length skirt. The long sleeves are semi-transparent with intricate floral embroidery, and the skirt also displays an ornate pattern of floral motifs on a lighter sheer overlay. The hem of the skirt is adorned with blue ruffles, and the dress is shown with a long, trailing train draped to the left. Additional sketch details include a smaller pattern of a plant with leaves in the upper right, a collar design on the left, and two sleeve pattern diagrams with labeled construction notes on the right. The entire composition is set against a plain, lightly shaded background.
title: Dress
